legend.soundAtlas.title: Soundscape (experimental)
legend.soundAtlas.link: Lines: listening point to source (aircraft = ground projection, dashed)
legend.soundAtlas.wavefront: Thunder wavefront: grows 343 m per second (illustrative, not a sound-pressure extent)
legend.soundAtlas.animation: Ripples, receiver pulse rings, raindrop rings and music notes only illustrate that a source is active now; their size and speed scale with relative potential, not sound-pressure range. Grey dashed ring = cannot determine (animations for aircraft, trains, rain, wind, surf and river are off by default; turn them on in the layer panel)
legend.soundAtlas.rail: Trains (surface/elevated, scheduled): underground sections are silent; sections of unknown structure show as unknown
legend.soundAtlas.roadTraffic: Road traffic: see the grid legend above; receiver links point to the strongest road
legend.soundAtlas.roadwork: Roadwork permit period (possible activity; a permit is not machinery running); Taipei City and other non-publishing cities: not covered
legend.soundAtlas.attribution: Sources: rail structure © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); roadwork TDX city planned events; roads TDX freeway conditions (congestion level, not volume)
legend.soundAtlas.roadTypical: Taipei road traffic: VD weekday typical values (Dec 2025–Jan 2026, about 8 sample days; not same-day observations); weekends, public holidays and anomalous days such as typhoons: unknown
legend.soundAtlas.wind: Wind in foliage: station wind speed × nearby tree canopy (activity proxy, not loudness; no urban wind noise inferred)
legend.soundAtlas.wave: Surf: offshore buoy wave height & period × distance to coast; beyond 1 km not counted
legend.soundAtlas.river: River water (experimental): level relative to the station's past 60 days × distance to channel; level ≠ flow ≠ sound, estuaries may reflect tides
legend.soundAtlas.naturalSnapshot: Wind, surf and river: on days with a full-area source file (currently 11/09 and 10/24) all of Taipei and New Taipei is covered; on other days only the area around scene snapshots has data, the grid is hatched, and live mode shows “Scene snapshots only”
legend.soundAtlas.naturalAttribution: Sources: CWA stations and buoys, WRA water levels (S3 archive); canopy height Meta/WRI 2020; NLMA coastal area extents (Open Government Data License v1)
legend.soundAtlas.rainGridTitle: Rain grid (Taipei + New Taipei, 250 m, every 10 min)
legend.soundAtlas.rainGridUnknown: Hatched = cannot tell (missing image, suspected clutter, no nearby gauge)
legend.soundAtlas.rainGridNote: Estimated from radar echo and rain gauges, taking the higher; the Z-R conversion and class thresholds are assumptions.
legend.soundAtlas.rainGridAnimation: Raindrop ripples are off by default; turn them on in the layer panel
legend.soundAtlas.roadGridTitle: Road traffic grid (Taipei + New Taipei, 250 m, every 10 min)
legend.soundAtlas.roadGridLevels: Light to dark: very low → very high (traffic sound potential, not dB)
legend.soundAtlas.roadGridUnknown: Hatched = road present but no data (Taipei weekends/holidays, beyond VD extension, minor streets, missing freeway data)
legend.soundAtlas.roadGridNote: Pale grey = very low or far from roads; the highest road in a cell wins; freeways are often near saturation in daytime.
legend.soundAtlas.roadGridAttribution: Sources: TDX freeway sections and VD, Taipei City VD; roads © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
legend.soundAtlas.potentialGrid.note: Each cell = the highest relative potential at its centre in these 10 minutes, same rules as the receiver panel; not dB. Hatching = undetermined (including days without full-area data).
legend.soundAtlas.potentialGrid.aviation: 3D slant distance from interpolated flight trails (0.5 at 2 km); switch the grid threshold in the layer panel — it only affects the grid.
legend.soundAtlas.potentialGrid.rail: Train positions from timetables; underground sections excluded, unknown structure hatched; same-day suspensions or delays not reflected. Track structure © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
legend.soundAtlas.potentialGrid.wind: Nearest station wind speed × canopy cover within 100 m (Meta/WRI); no canopy = none.
legend.soundAtlas.potentialGrid.wave: Nearest buoy wave height and period × distance to the nearshore zone; more than 1 km inland = none.
legend.soundAtlas.potentialGrid.river: Nearest gauge's level percentile over the past 60 days × distance to the channel; water level ≠ flow ≠ sound.
